brief: HYPE crowding is gone: funding fell back to 10.95 and premium to -2.21 bps while price stayed +18.95 over 24h, so the HYPE short is cancelled on premise. XMR remains the largest imbalance (funding 97.12, 67.12 points over CEX, 1d rangePos 0.59), still short of the tripwire. One new plan: XPL short on a 4h sweep high in a 1d downtrend with OI +9.97 over 24h; low conviction, and it risks a squeeze off the 1w low. WLD long passed under L1 until a reclaim close. Gap: hl-cycles is stale (12.7 h), so the regime read is mild_risk_off from old data.
